title: Myrtle Avenue at 80th Street
description: Green street signs reading Myrtle Av and 80 St hang over the intersection on a bright day. A three-storey brick corner building carries a hair salon and a dermatology office at sidewalk level, with apartment windows and iron balconies above, and a row of low storefronts under awnings recedes along the avenue.
author: DoomDan515
